blocks.x: No, we hadn't gotten to your being in the Detention Home.
I don't think you told me. You told me you were in a Detention Home.
I told ya how my mother got me out! Didn't I tell you that?
By going to -- taking me out of there -- to Louisville, didn't I tell you that?
Well, then, what point are you making?
